_comment: VS Code Copilot Agent Hooks (Preview) config. Installed to .github/hooks/route.json when the project has NO .claude/settings.json (which VS Code also reads — installing both would fire the hook twice). Enforces progressive discovery: on every prompt, route-hook.py injects the route-first mandate + the router's suggested node set. Uses VS Code's single-nested hooks format. See https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/hooks Fail-open; a missing script prints one 'cypress: hook script missing' line instead of nothing.

UserPromptSubmit.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.github/hooks/route-hook.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f" || true; else echo "cypress: hook script missing: $f; continuing without it. Re-run install.sh to restore it."; fi
